caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden coffee grinder with dovetail joints on its corners. The grinder has a flat top surface, which features a round metal opening with a hinged lid, and a metal crank handle with a twisted design extending upward and outward from the top right, ending in a bulbous, dark-colored knob. The front face of the grinder displays a red label that reads "UTILITY COFFEE MILLS" in yellow and white letters, with an emblem in the center. At the base of the front face is a small drawer with a round dark knob, designed to collect the ground coffee. The wooden surfaces are rendered in shades of brown to convey a natural wood grain texture, and the metal components are depicted in gray and black tones. The background is plain and off-white, emphasizing the object. The artist’s name, “ARCHIE THOMPSON,” appears printed in small letters in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Coffee Grinder
